name: authentik-authorize-4xx-mereka-lms
description: Count 4xx+ responses from Authentik /application/o/authorize for the mereka-lms OAuth client (often redirect_uri mismatch).
filter: resource.type="k8s_container" AND resource.labels.namespace_name="authentik" AND resource.labels.container_name="server" AND jsonPayload.event=~"^/application/o/authorize/\\?client_id=mereka-lms(&|$)" AND (jsonPayload.status>=400 OR jsonPayload.status_code>=400)
